IF YOU WANT AI TO WRITE CODE YOU CAN SHIP, STOP PASTING BLINDLY.

MEMORIZE THESE 5 RULES:

Give the model your constraints first.

Stack, versions, style rules, what done looks like. Vague prompts get vague code.

Review every diff like a junior wrote it.

AI code looks confident and fails quietly. Read it line by line before it touches main.

Keep humans on architecture.

Let AI fill functions, never design systems. You own the boundaries, it fills the boxes.

I post daily breakdowns like this for backend, SQL, and interviews.

Follow @owlsky17 so you don't miss the next one.
THINGS AI CODING ASSISTANTS CAN'T TELL YOU (SO VERIFY THEM YOURSELF):

Whether the code actually runs.

It completes patterns, it doesn't execute. Run everything before trusting anything.

Whether the dependencies exist.

Hallucinated imports and phantom APIs are the number one AI bug. Check every import.

Whether it fits your codebase.

Generated code ignores your conventions. Adapt it to your style or it rots on contact.
